description:
Activate Solarion by tapping it, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Solarion using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Solarion.
Repeat.

uses.name: Solarion
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it
